adjudication.rationale: In `app/serializers/embeddable_host_serializer.rb`, the serializer lists `attributes :id, :host, :category_id` and then defines `def id; object.id; end`, `def host; object.host; end`, and `def category_id; object.category_id; end`, which are indeed redundant. However, this is a minor style/cleanup nit rather than a verifiable defect or an important diff-grounded non-bug issue affecting behavior.
